主要内容: Funding Circle and INTRUST Bank announced a strategic partnership to support the growth of US small businesses. The partnership will be rolled out in various stages, starting with INTRUST funding US small business loans originated through Funding Circle. Later stages include growing the investment into a multi-year funding program and joint digital and direct marketing campaigns. INTRUST joins over 70,000 investors who have provided $5 billion in financing to more than 40,000 businesses, creating 100,000 jobs. Through the partnership, INTRUST will support access to credit for hundreds of US entrepreneurs, spurring job creation and boosting the American economy. The partnership highlights the importance of small businesses as the lifeblood of communities and the nation's economy. Funding Circle enables investors to lend to creditworthy small businesses, offering attractive risk-adjusted returns. The partnership reflects a commitment to bringing tangible impact to the communities served by INTRUST Bank and Funding Circle.
